meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye India mein meri first choice **10% Vitamin C** se start karna hoga, especially agar pehli baar use kar rahe ho.

### 🥇 Meri pick: Minimalist Vitamin C 10%
### [Minimalist Vitamin C 10% Face Serum]()
*₹284*

Isme **10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid + 1% Acetyl Glucosamine** hai. Formula fragrance-free/non-comedogenic hai aur specifically dullness, sun damage aur dark spots ke liye marketed hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/vitamin-c-ethyl-ascorbic-acid-10-acetyl-glucosamine-1?_pos=5&_sid=5fed91241&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar budget ~₹300 hai:** ye best starting option hai.

### 🥈 Dark spots ke liye strong alternative: Deconstruct 10%
### [Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C Serum]()
*₹458*

10% liposomal Vitamin C + **0.5% ferulic acid**; brand ke according pigmentation, uneven tone aur dullness target karta hai. Fragrance-free bhi hai. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/serums/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥉 Agar Vitamin C ke saath pigmentation-focused formula chahiye
### [Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E + 5% Niacinamide Serum]()
*₹278*

Isme **10% Vitamin C + 5% niacinamide + Vitamin E** hai, aur brand dark spots/pigmentation/dullness ke liye formulate karta hai. Current official price ₹591/30 ml listed hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/collections/vitamin-c-skin-care/products/dot-key-10-vitamin-c-e-5-niacinamide-serum-for-glowing-skin-beginner-friendly?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Mera verdict:**  
- **Beginner + sensitive skin:** Minimalist 10%  
- **Dark spots/pigmentation priority:** Deconstruct 10%  
- **Dark spots + glow + niacinamide:** Dot & Key  

**Important:** Vitamin C ke saath morning mein **SPF 30–50 sunscreen** zaroor lagana, warna dark spots wapas/darker ho sakte hain. Pehle 2–3 weeks alternate mornings se start karna bhi sensible hai.

Agar tum mujhe **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive) aur budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main **sirf 1 best serum** choose karke bata dunga.
